title: Doody Calls - Turd World War
summary: Squad up and flush out the Doodies: a full family-friendly 3D shooter.
description:
*** Xbox Game Controller and HDMI output recommended ***

Doody Calls – Turd World War is the full first-person 3D shooter from Software Amusements.

The Doodies have risen from the sewers and only your squad stands in their way. Fight across nine sectors, from the sewage works and the high street to a beach landing, a snowy mountain ridge and a container ship. Face Poo-copters, Doody Tanks, the Poonami, The Big Stinker and the Giga Poo, armed with the Plunger, the U-Bend .50 sniper, Air Freshener grenades and a trusty toilet brush.

Climb 200 ranks, earn 30 medals and post your score on the online leaderboard, shared with
the web version. Family friendly, always.

Play it your way: on the built-in keyboard, with a mouse, or with a Bluetooth Xbox controller. Plug in an HDMI screen and the game moves to the big screen.

Sectors 1-3 are free. The Supporter Pack (sectors 4-6 plus perks) and the Expansion Pack (sectors 7-9) are US$1.99 each: scan the QR code in the game to buy on your phone and then type in your unlock code. Codes work on the web version too.
